Priya (PM): Quick sync: I pushed a draft PRD for 'Docs-as-spec: Config-driven endpoint examples' — need quick acceptance criteria so docs can land as the spec. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/PRD-421
Jordan (Eng): saw it. high-level looks ok. main ask: unit tests + rollout plan. can docs include curl examples for both hosted + dedicated?
Sam (Docs): yes, we should require runnable examples. proposal: 3 quickstarts — hosted API, dedicated (reserved), private VPC. each with minimal config and expected response.
Anya (Design): also add an example for error-state UX (rate limit / degraded model). keeps expectations clear for product.
Priya (PM): Acceptance criteria proposal (short):
• Docs include 3 quickstarts (hosted, dedicated, private)
• Each quickstart has: minimal config, example request, expected response snippet, note on costs
• One example each for success & error path
• Code samples in JS + curl
• 'Rollout checklist' section with canary traffic %s and fallback policy
Jordan (Eng): FYI constraints:
- Dedicated quickstart needs a JSON config block for pool size and autoscale threshold
- Private needs KMS snippet
Mike (Platform): I can add platform-side config templates. question: do docs-as-spec accept a yaml sample for autoscale or must it be CLI? what do we prefer?
Sam (Docs): prefer YAML + CLI alt. We can include both; YAML is primary for readability.
Priya (PM): Edge cases to call out:
- Model mismatch when fallback triggers: expected fields and behavior
- Request timeouts vs streaming partials
- Quota enforcement on dedicated pools
Luis (CS): add an example of a customer ask for deterministic routing when region unavailable. we had a support case last month.
Priya (PM): Proposal to move to RFC if no objections by EOD: RFC should contain: detailed schema for quickstarts, test harness for examples (automated verification), rollout metrics & SLOs, and migration notes for customers.
deploy-bot: PRD draft uploaded by priya at 2026-03-15T14:12:10Z
Jordan (Eng): +1 to RFC. i'll volunteer to write the 'test harness' section with a simple curl-based verification script.
Sam (Docs): I'll draft examples and the verification matrix. can we get an engineer to pair-review for accuracy?
Mike (Platform): I'll review the config templates.
Priya (PM): Okay — owners:
- RFC lead: Priya
- Test harness: Jordan
- Docs/examples: Sam
- Platform templates: Mike
- CS edgecases: Luis
Next steps: Sam will post a doc checklist by tomorrow; Jordan will drop a small verification script in a gist. if anyone has blocking concerns tag @priya.
Anya (Design): lgtm. small nit: include expected UI copy for rate-limit message so mobile apps render consistently.
Priya (PM): noted. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
